correctness.rationale: The 12 vertices and exact ℤ[φ] operations reconstruct all 495 determinants (two implementations agree), with histogram 75,30,180,180,30. The exact signed determinant bound follows by separate affinity, not by sampling interior positions. Equality of convex combinations forces all active vertex quadruples to be extremal with common sign; the checker exhausts all possible 3-vertex bases, finds 20 pairs of bases with 3 allowed apex vertices, verifies each apex triple is a supporting triangular facet, and excludes every 2x2 grid needed for two nonvertex tetrahedron vertices. The exact volume fraction follows from 20 pyramids, normalized by the icosahedron face inradius. The included finite checker is executable and fully exhaustive for this finite problem.

value.rationale: This gives a natural and complete exact volume spectrum of tetrahedra from an exceptional regular three-dimensional polytope and the sharp largest-contained-simplex fraction, not an arbitrarily selected subset or a textbook substitution. The additionally rigorous classification of an uncountable two-dimensional equality locus and the precise 30 finite vertex extremizers expose unexpectedly non-rigid extremality relevant to convex-polytope simplex optimization. The full facet-wise characterization goes beyond an isolated computed number and has independent geometric meaning.
